title: Shenling Qige Granules inhibit esophageal squamous cell carcinoma progression in TE-1 xenograft and cell-based models by modulating the DCN-TGF-beta/Smad signaling axis.
authors: Liu, Zihui; Gu, Yiting; Fan, Huanfang; Huang, Mao; Li, Dehui; Guo, Wen; He, Yun; Zhang, Shuang; Du, Zhihua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过DCN-TGF-beta/Smad轴抑制食管鳞癌，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是肿瘤药理与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Shenling Qige Granules (SLQG), derived from the Qing Dynasty formula Qige San recorded in Yi Xue Xin Wu, has been used in clinical practice in China as an adjuvant traditional Chinese medicine preparation for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), but its molecular basis remains unclear. This study investigated the antitumor effects and mechanisms of SLQG using TE-1 xenograft mice and SLQG-containing serum-treated TE-1 cells. Transcriptome sequencing, network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and public-database analysis were integrated to prioritize candidate mechanisms. Histological, molecular, cellular, and siRNA-mediated decorin (DCN) knockdown assays were performed for validation. SLQG, especially at the medium dose, inhibited xenograft tumor growth and increased DCN expression. Transcriptomic analysis highlighted the transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta)/Smad pathway. In silico analyses suggested that several SLQG-derived compounds, particularly ursolic acid, may be associated with DCN-related regulation. Public-database analysis indicated lower DCN expression in esophageal carcinoma tumor samples than in normal samples and an association with pathological stage. In vivo and in vitro, SLQG increased DCN expression, reduced Smad2/3 phosphorylation, promoted pro-apoptotic signaling, and induced G0/G1 arrest; these effects were attenuated by DCN knockdown. These findings suggest that SLQG inhibited ESCC progression in TE-1 xenograft and cell-based models, potentially through modulation of the DCN-associated TGF-beta/Smad signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 沈灵七葛颗粒（SLQG）源自清代方剂七葛散，记载于《医学心悟》，在中国临床上作为食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）的辅助中药制剂使用，但其分子基础尚不清楚。本研究利用TE-1异种移植小鼠及含SLQG血清处理的TE-1细胞，探讨了SLQG的抗肿瘤效应及其机制。整合转录组测序、网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及公共数据库分析，以优先确定候选机制。通过组织学、分子、细胞及siRNA介导的decorin（DCN）敲低实验进行验证。SLQG，尤其是中剂量，抑制了异种移植肿瘤生长并增加DCN表达。转录组分析强调了转化生长因子-β（TGF-beta）/Smad通路。计算机模拟分析提示，SLQG中的若干化合物，特别是熊果酸，可能与DCN相关调控有关。公共数据库分析显示，食管癌肿瘤样本中DCN表达低于正常样本，并与病理分期相关。在体内和体外，SLQG增加DCN表达，减少Smad2/3磷酸化，促进促凋亡信号传导，并诱导G0/G1期阻滞；这些效应在DCN敲低后被减弱。这些发现表明，SLQG在TE-1异种移植及细胞模型中抑制ESCC进展，可能通过调节DCN相关的TGF-beta/Smad信号轴实现。
